content: {"phoneNote":"The hero photo is pushed below the fold and its arch is sliced off at the right edge of the viewport, so the first screen is a text-only card with a half-visible picture poking out underneath.","desktopNote":"The label card beside the arched cheese photo makes a strong, specific first screen, but further down the product cards and gift section carry large dead areas and no cheese photos.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":4,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Give the three product cards real photos of the cheeses instead of the same branch ornament, and tighten the gap between name and price so the cards don't look half-empty.","On phone, shrink the hero card so the cheese photo shows on the first screen, and keep the arch fully inside the viewport instead of bleeding off the right edge.","Reduce the empty red band under the gift-section circle and the white padding around the quote on desktop; use a cheese or gift-box photo rather than a meadow in the gift block."],"blockers":["Phone hero: the arched cheese photo is cut off at the right edge of the screen, leaving only a partial arch visible."]}
